entries.2011f0b7b761c124: This reportable segment provides equipment, materials, information processing services and maintenance for electronic media and microfilm integrated systems, functional materials, equipment, materials and maintenance for printing systems and IPS (business card and postcard printing) systems, equipment and maintenance for laser processing machines, and equipment, materials and maintenance for industrial inspection. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥17,782 million. The company, together with Musashi Field Support Co., Ltd., M.B.S. Co., Ltd., F.B.M. Co., Ltd., Musashi ABC Co., Ltd., Musashi Image Joho Co., Ltd. and Musashi I Techno Co., Ltd., undertakes this business, and J.I.M. Co., Ltd. is involved as an equity-method affiliate.
entries.2315c699b7f9b7e9: This business sells and maintains currency processing equipment and related equipment. It also proposes management equipment that contributes to strengthening internal controls at financial institutions, as well as various management systems and BPO services for centralized processing of branch operations. Musashi Engineering Co., Ltd. is responsible for developing and manufacturing software and currency counting and sorting machines, among others.
entries.23aec28c5ae0bb12: This business provides operations utilizing digitization equipment such as scanners and AI-OCR, LTO tape, equipment and materials for electronic media and microfilm integrated systems, information processing services and maintenance. In document digitization, the company proposes operational efficiency through digitization to government agencies and local governments, and for private companies it uses one of the largest imaging centers in Japan. Subsidiary Musashi ABC Co., Ltd. handles materials sales and data entry outsourcing, and Musashi Image Joho Co., Ltd. handles materials sales and data entry outsourcing.
entries.2add240844024e76: Information, Printing and Industrial Systems Equipment
entries.3059b7956776b151: This business sells and maintains security system equipment and related equipment. Within financial general-purpose system equipment, sales of security equipment are progressing favorably.
entries.3956d70bfae1018f: This business sells processed paper products and pressure-sensitive paper. The subsidiary M.B.S. Co., Ltd. also manufactures and sells thermal enlargement printers and pressure-sensitive paper.
entries.3ede79bbd000ad36: This reportable segment provides equipment, related materials and maintenance for currency processing, election and security systems. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,880 million. The company, together with Musashi Engineering Co., Ltd., which is responsible for developing and manufacturing financial general-purpose and election system equipment, and Musashi Field Support Co., Ltd., which is responsible for maintenance, handles this business.
entries.4496c5261e48d1f5: This business sells and provides support for election equipment, such as ballot issuing machines and reading and sorting machines, as well as vote counting and management systems. It focuses on developing equipment and business management systems that streamline election administration, and is also advancing support for election business management software in response to the standardization of municipal information systems.
entries.44fe9b398b468ef0: This reportable segment engages in real estate leasing, equipment leasing, non-life insurance agency and staffing businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥297 million. Musashi Kosan Co., Ltd. is responsible for real estate leasing, and Musashi Enterprise Co., Ltd. is responsible for leasing, non-life insurance agency and staffing businesses.
entries.4c6d9e39495d4b91: This business is the real estate leasing conducted by Musashi Kosan Co., Ltd. It was originally established as a real estate management company.
entries.7bf525da14b22986: This business provides equipment, materials and maintenance for industrial inspection and sells functional materials. For commercial filtration filters, the business is working to expand sales to semiconductor and electronic component customers and to sell them for beverages, and for industrial inspection equipment it is capturing demand for infrastructure inspection and demand related to aviation and space.

entries.89885c974325aa1f: This business consists of leasing, including vehicle leasing, non-life insurance agency and staffing services, conducted by Musashi Enterprise Co., Ltd.
entries.a04dffd54b1cc7f3: A trading company that sells system equipment for elections and finance, information and printing equipment, and paper and processed paper products.

entries.b76fdee1143ae52b: This reportable segment sells printing, publishing, information and office paper, paperboard for paper containers, specialty paper, processed paper products and pressure-sensitive paper. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,625 million. The company and M.B.S. Co., Ltd. are responsible for this segment, and sales of paperboard for paper containers for pharmaceutical and cosmetics products are progressing favorably. It also works to provide original products that meet customer needs.
entries.e1f553823f54bb99: This business sells printing, publishing, information and office paper, paperboard for paper containers for pharmaceutical and cosmetics products, among others, and specialty paper.
entries.ea676d684c0bb72b: This business provides printing systems, equipment and materials and maintenance for IPS systems for business card and postcard printing, and equipment and maintenance for laser processing machines. The business is working to expand sales of distinctive products, such as multipurpose inkjet printers and digital die cutters, and its in-house developed software. Subsidiary F.B.M. Co., Ltd. sells printing equipment and OA equipment.
